label: gym_normal_040_gym_receptionist_01
text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Welcome to the Medali Gym,\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)].

label: gym_normal_040_gym_receptionist_02
text: If you want to face Gym Leader Larry, please\nspeak to the waiter at the Treasure Eatery.

label: gym_normal_040_receptionist_00
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Ah, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]! Welcome to the
Treasure
Eatery—proud
to
be
supporting
the
Medali Gym!

label: gym_normal_040_receptionist_01
text: Do you want to face the Exceptional Everyman\nhimself, Gym Leader Larry?

label: gym_normal_040_receptionist_02
text: In that case, please head onto the battle court.

label: gym_normal_040_receptionist_03
text: Please feel free to come back whenever you\nare ready.

label: gym_normal_040_receptionist_05
text: Laaarrryyy! You’re up!

label: gym_normal_040_normal_01
text: Hello.[VAR 0x0114(002C)]

label: gym_normal_040_normal_02
text: I’m Larry. I’m assigned to work as the Gym\nLeader of the Medali Gym.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: gym_normal_040_normal_03
text: Good job on making your way through the\nGym Test.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: gym_normal_040_normal_04
text: And, well...maybe try the other dishes on the\nmenu too sometime. Everything’s good here.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: gym_normal_040_normal_05
text: Anyway, my boss will dock my pay if I spend too\nmuch time chitchatting.\c\nLet’s get this battle over with.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: gym_normal_040_normal_06
text: Thank you for doing business with us today.\nI, Larry, will be at your service.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: gym_normal_040_normal_07
text: You’re rather strong, aren’t you? Enough to bring\nout my poker face, even.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: gym_normal_040_normal_08
text: I lost, so that means I have to give you a\nbadge, but...[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: gym_normal_040_normal_09
text: That battle made me a bit hungry. Care to join\nme for a meal?[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: gym_normal_040_normal_badge
text: Having [VAR 0x0200(0001)] Gym Badge[VAR 0x1101(0001,0100)]s in hand makes it easier to\ncatch Pokémon of up to Lv. [VAR 0x0201(0002)].\c\nOh, and they’ll actually listen to you, too...[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: gym_normal_040_normal_badge_all
text: If you have 8 Gym Badges, you’ll be able to\ncatch Pokémon of any level. They’ll never\r\nquestion who’s the boss, either.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: gym_normal_040_normal_10
text: The dishes here... They’ve all got flavor.\nGood flavor, I mean.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: gym_normal_040_normal_waza
text: This is for you. Though hopefully a child like you\nhas no need to put on its namesake...[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: gym_normal_040_normal_11
text: Oh, don’t worry about the bill. I do earn a salary,\nafter all.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: gym_normal_040_normal_12
text: Now, I’d better get back to work. If you’ll\nexcuse me.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

label: gym_normal_040_receptionist_04
text: Congratulations! You’re now certified by the\nMedali Gym!

label: gym_normal_040_normal_npc
text: *munch munch* *gulp*[VAR 0x0114(0015)]
